rule: all panel choices on the 962 development patients only; the 413 internal-test patients are scored once per analysis with these panels

multiclass.selection: highest development 4-fold CV objective among 3,000 candidates (stage1_objective)

disease_specific.selection: smallest of the top 1-18 development-LASSO-ranked proteins within 0.02 CV AUC and 0.05 CV balanced accuracy of the best (5-fold development CV); floor 2 if the top protein is Bonferroni-significant in >1 cancer
